title: How to follow up with your Free ALIVE Sample leads
titleHtml: How to follow up with your Free ALIVE Sample leads
sub: Use these scripts the same day a sample request comes in.

video.title: Funnel scripts training video
video.caption: Watch this before you start calling.

steps.title: Check your texts first
steps.lead: The confirmation page asks them to text you the word CONFIRM, so a lot of leads have already opened the conversation before you get to them. Look before you dial:
script: If they already texted CONFIRM, skip step 2. Reply to the thread they started, confirm the address, and ship it.
If nothing came through, check your Unknown Senders or Spam folder in Messages. Their text may be sitting in there.
Then work through the steps below in order.

steps.title: Call them
steps.lead: They probably won't pick up, so leave this voicemail:
script: Hey [Name], it's [Your Name]!
I saw you just requested a free sample of ALIVE, and I'm the one getting it in the mail to you.
I only need one thing before it goes out, and that's to make sure I have the right address. I'm going to text you now, so just reply to that and I'll get it sent.

If you don't see my text, check your Unknown Senders or Spam folder. On an iPhone, look for the filter or menu icon in the top right corner of your Messages app, it's usually three little lines. On an Android, look for the three-dot menu. Any filtered messages land there, which is where my text to you might be.
Okay, that's all for now! Talk soon.

steps.title: Text them
steps.lead: As soon as you hang up, send this:
script: Hey [Name], it's [Your Name]! 👋 Just left you a quick voicemail. You requested a free sample of ALIVE and I want to get it in the mail to you today.
Can you confirm this is where I'm sending it? [Address]
Reply YES and it goes out. It's a couple of single serve sticks, one in hot water, ready in about sixty seconds.

steps.title: Email them too
steps.lead: Send this the same day. Plenty of people read email before they answer an unknown number:
script: Subject: Confirming where to send your ALIVE sample
Hi [Name],
You requested a free sample of ALIVE and I'm getting it packed up for you. Before it goes out, can you confirm this address is right? [Address]
Just reply to this email and I'll drop it in the mail. Samples are limited, so the sooner you confirm the sooner yours ships.
[Your Name]

steps.title: Follow up in 24 hrs
steps.lead: If they don't confirm within 24 hours, text again:
script: [Name]! Just following up on my text above! 👆 I still have your ALIVE sample set aside. Send me a quick yes on the address and I'll get it out to you today.

steps.title: Tell them it shipped
steps.lead: Send this the day it actually goes in the mail. Not before:
script: Hey [Name], it's [Your Name]! Just letting you know your ALIVE sample is in the mail and on its way to you. 📦
Can't wait to hear what you think. One stick in hot water, give it about a minute, and drink it the way you'd drink your normal coffee.

steps.title: Email the same notice
steps.lead: Send this alongside the text, so it is in both places when they go looking:
script: Subject: Your ALIVE sample is on its way
Hi [Name],
Your free ALIVE sample went in the mail today and is on its way to you.
When it lands, tear a stick into hot water and give it about a minute. It's real Arabica coffee, so treat it like your normal cup. Black, or with whatever you usually add.
I'll check in once you've had a chance to try it. Anything you want to know before then, just reply to this.
[Your Name]

steps.title: Check in a few days later
steps.lead: Give it time to arrive and be tried. Five to seven days after you shipped it:
script: Hey [Name]! Did your ALIVE sample land ok? 👋
What did you think? I want to hear the honest answer, good or bad.

steps.title: Offer them the pouch
steps.lead: Only once they've told you they liked it. This is the step the whole sample was for:
script: Love that. If you want to keep going, the full pouch is 30 sticks, so it's a month of mornings.
Here's my link: [Your ALIVE Link]
Order through that and I'm still the one you text if anything comes up.

tip: Tip: Personalize [Name], [Your Name] and [Your ALIVE Link], and paste their real address into [Address] before you send. Steps 6 to 9 only happen once the sample is physically in the mail, so send them on your own timing, not the same day the lead comes in. Never send step 9 before they have actually tried it. The sample is what earns the ask.
